_comment: Copy to print-drop.config.json (untracked) for per-deployment settings. Precedence: command-line flag > environment variable > this file > built-in default. This file is the only one the shipped startup task reads, since it runs the entrypoint with no arguments.
name: Oshal Print to File Printer
uuid: pin this to the previous value when renaming the printer, otherwise installed client queues point at an identity that no longer answers - omit the key entirely to derive it from hostname + name
